Privacidade.metaDescription: Learn how Yzev Tech handles the personal data submitted through the site's contact form.
Privacidade.title: Privacy Notice

sections.title: 1. Who is responsible for this data
sections.body: This notice explains how Yzev Tech ("Yzev", "we") handles the personal data collected through this site, in accordance with Brazil's General Data Protection Law (Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais, Law No. 13,709/2018 — LGPD). For questions or requests related to privacy, contact us at contato@yzev.tech

sections.title: 2. Cookies and similar technologies
sections.body: The site uses the NEXT_LOCALE cookie, tied to navigation between the available languages (Portuguese, English and Spanish). In the configuration we observed, it's a session cookie and holds the selected language code. As of this review, we haven't identified any advertising cookies or analytics tools in use. This may be revisited if new services or technologies are added to the site.

sections.title: 3. What data we collect
sections.body: We collect the personal data you voluntarily provide when filling out the contact form, such as name, company, email address, WhatsApp number, selected need, and message content. Please share only the information necessary for us to understand and respond to your request.

sections.title: 4. What we use this data for and who we share it with
sections.body: We use the data to understand your request, respond to your contact, and follow up on it. The form uses Web3Forms (web3forms.com) to forward messages to our corporate email address. Processing follows that service's applicable terms and privacy practices. We don't sell the personal data submitted through the form or use it for marketing campaigns without a proper legal basis. Sharing may occur when necessary to carry out the request, comply with legal obligations, or in other cases permitted by law.

sections.title: 5. How long we keep the data
sections.body: We keep the data for as long as necessary to respond to the request, follow up on it, and meet any legal obligations. After that period, the data is deleted or anonymized where applicable, except where retention is required or permitted by law. Since the form is processed by Web3Forms (web3forms.com), the submitted message may also remain stored in that provider's systems for its own retention period, as described in its privacy policy — we don't have direct control over that timeframe. You can request information about data retention or deletion through the contact channel listed in this notice.

sections.title: 6. Your rights
sections.body: Under the LGPD, you may request, as applicable, confirmation that processing is taking place, access to your data, correction of incomplete, inaccurate or outdated data, anonymization, blocking or deletion of unnecessary, excessive, or non-compliant data, as well as other rights provided by law. Where processing is based on consent, you may withdraw it. To exercise your rights, contact us at the address below.

sections.title: 7. Contact
sections.body: For questions, requests, or any matters related to privacy and the handling of personal data, write to contato@yzev.tech
